title: Jeremiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 15
description: Ten questions on Jeremiah 15: even Moses and Samuel could not turn Yahweh's mind, four kinds of destroyers, eaten words, and a fortified bronze wall.

questions.text: Which two men does Yahweh name, saying even their standing before Him would not turn His mind toward this people?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said, "Though Moses and Samuel stood before me, yet my mind would not turn toward this people."

answers.text: Abraham and David
Noah and Job
Moses and Samuel
Jacob and Aaron

questions.text: When the people ask "Where shall we go out?", what answer must the speaker give?
questions.explanation: The speaker must say, "Such as are for death, to death; such as are for the sword, to the sword; such as are for the famine, to the famine; and such as are for captivity, to captivity."

answers.text: To death, the sword, the famine, or captivity
To Egypt, to Moab, to Edom, or to Ammon
To the mountains, the caves, and the rocks
To Babylon to serve the king seventy years

questions.text: Which four kinds does Yahweh say He will appoint over them?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says, "I will appoint over them four kinds: the sword to kill, the dogs to tear, the birds of the sky, and the animals of the earth, to devour and to destroy."

answers.text: Fire from heaven, hail, famine and pestilence
The sword, the dogs, the birds of the sky and the animals of the earth
The lions, the bears, the wolves and the leopards
The drought, the locusts, the serpents and the storm

questions.text: Because of which king will Yahweh cause them to be tossed back and forth among all the kingdoms of the earth?
questions.explanation: It is because of Manasseh, the son of Hezekiah, king of Judah, for that which he did in Jerusalem.

answers.text: Jehoiakim
Ahab
Zedekiah
Manasseh

questions.text: With what does Yahweh say He has winnowed them in the gates of the land?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says, "I have winnowed them with a fan in the gates of the land. I have bereaved them of children."

answers.text: With a fan
With a sieve
With the east wind
With a threshing sledge

questions.text: How numerous have their widows become, according to Yahweh?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says, "Their widows are increased more than the sand of the seas."

answers.text: More than the stars of the sky
More than the drops of the dew
More than the grass of the field
More than the sand of the seas

questions.text: What did the speaker do with Yahweh's words when they were found?
questions.explanation: He says, "Your words were found, and I ate them. Your words were to me a joy and the rejoicing of my heart."

answers.text: He wrote them on a scroll
He ate them, and they became his joy
He hid them in his house
He proclaimed them at the gates

questions.text: Why did the speaker sit alone instead of sitting with those who make merry?
questions.explanation: He says, "I sat alone because of your hand, for you have filled me with indignation."

answers.text: Because all his friends had abandoned him in his trouble
Because he was sick with grief over the slain
Because of Yahweh's hand, for He had filled him with indignation
Because he was hiding himself from the anger of the king

questions.text: What does the speaker fear Yahweh will become to him?
questions.explanation: He asks, "Will you indeed be to me as a deceitful brook, like waters that fail?"

answers.text: As a deceitful brook, like waters that fail
As a consuming fire
As an enemy with a drawn sword
As a dream that vanishes at dawn

questions.text: What does Yahweh say He will make the speaker to this people?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says, "I will make you to this people a fortified bronze wall. They will fight against you, but they will not prevail against you."

answers.text: A watchman on the tower
A fortified bronze wall
A sharp threshing instrument
A light in the darkness
